1.text: Inyamibwa mu ndirimbo za Salomo. Umugeni:

2.text: Ansome no gusoma k'umunwa we,Kuko urukundo unkunda rundutira vino.

3.text: Imibavu yawe ihumura neza,Izina ryawe rimeze nk'amadahano atāmye,Ni cyo gituma abakobwa bagukunda.

4.text: Unkurure twiruke inyuma yawe tugukurikiye.Umwami yanjyanye mu rugo rwe,Tuzanezerwa tukwishimana,Tuzasingiza urukundo rwawe tururutisha vino,Bafite impamvu rwose bagukundira.

5.text: Yemwe bakobwa b'i Yerusalemu mwe,Ndirabura ariko ndi mwiza,Nsa n'amahema y'Abakedari,N'inyegamo za Salomo.

6.text: Mwe kundeba nabi ni uko nirabura,Nabitewe n'izuba ryambabuye.Abahungu ba mama barandakariye,Bangize umurinzi w'inzabibu,Ariko uruzabibu rwanjye sinarurinze.

7.text: Yewe uwo nkundisha umutima,Mbwira aho uragira n'aho ubyagiza ku manywa,Kuki namera nk'uwatwikiririwe,Hafi y'imikumbi ya bagenzi bawe? Umukwe:

8.text: Niba utabizi, wa mugore we,Uri indatwa mu bagore.Genda ukurikire mu nkōra y'umukumbi,Uragire abana b'ihene bawe iruhande rw'amahema y'abungeri.

9.text: Wa mukunzi wanjye we,Nakugereranije n'ifarashi ikurura amagare ya Farawo.

10.text: Mu misaya yawe ni heza hashotsemo imishunzi,Ijosi ryawe ririmbishwa n'inigi z'amasaro y'igiciro cyinshi.

11.text: Tuzakuremera imikufi y'izahabu,Duteremo amabara y'ifeza. Umugeni:

12.text: Igihe umwami yabaga yicaye ku meza ye,Impumuro y'amadahano yanjye yaratāmaga.

13.text: Umukunzi wanjye yamereye nk'ishangi,Iri hagati y'amabere yanjye. Umukwe:

14.text: Umukunzi wanjye amereye nk'uburabyo bwa Koferi,Buba mu nzabibu zo muri Enigedi.

15.text: Mukunzi wanjye we, uri mwiza,Ni koko uri mwiza,Amaso yawe ni nk'ay'inyana. Umugeni:

16.text: Dore uri mwiza mukunzi wanjye,Ni ukuri uranezeza,Uburiri bwacu ni ubwatsi bugitoha.

17.text: Inkingi z'inzu yacu ni imyerezi,N'imishoro yayo ni imiberoshi.
